# Contributing

This tap only holds the Homebrew cask for [InputConfig](https://github.com/ryleighnewman/InputConfig). The cask
is updated with every release, so changes to it are made by the maintainer.

- For a problem installing or upgrading with Homebrew, open an issue with the **Install problem** form.
- For anything about the app itself, use the [InputConfig repository](https://github.com/ryleighnewman/InputConfig/issues).
- For a security issue, see the [security policy](SECURITY.md).
